params.text: The attack time, 0 to 10 seconds; with a cable at ATTACK it attenuates that CV instead
The decay time, 0 to 10 seconds; with a cable at DECAY it attenuates that CV instead
Runs continuously, with no trigger needed
A new trigger during the decay re-enters the attack from the level the envelope has reached; and if the trigger voltage is high when a cycle ends, another begins

inputs.text: A trigger or gate starts the cycle, which then runs to its end; the channels patched here set the polyphony
A 0-10V CV over the attack time, attenuated by the ATTACK knob
A 0-10V CV over the decay time, attenuated by the DECAY knob

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 5V when the cycle ends

menu: Invert output — multiplies the envelope by -1, so it runs from 0V down to -10V
